tools.name: add_to_comparison
tools.description: Adds this page’s product to the shopper’s side-by-side comparison for its category; never removes one.

product_id.description: Numeric BestPrice product id, as any tool returns it.

tools.name: add_to_shopping_list
tools.description: Adds this page’s product to the shopper’s shopping list; never removes one.

product_id.description: Numeric BestPrice product id, as any tool returns it.

tools.name: apply_listing_filter
tools.description: Applies one filter value to this listing and reloads it.

filter.description: A filter name or key as get_listing_filters returned it.

value.description: A value as get_listing_filters returned it; a unique part of it also works.

tools.name: apply_listing_sort
tools.description: Sorts this listing by a sort key or option label.

sort.description: A sort key or option label from get_listing_filters; a unique part of a label also works.

tools.name: clear_listing_filters
tools.description: Removes one filter value, one filter or every filter from this listing.

filter.description: Remove only this filter (name or key from get_listing_filters). Without it, every filter goes.

value.description: With filter: remove only this selected value of it.

tools.name: compare_page_offers
tools.description: Ranks this product’s store offers by delivered price, item plus shipping; changes nothing.

limit.description: Offers to return, from 1 to 12. Defaults to 4.

offset.description: Use next_offset from the previous result to read the next offers. Defaults to 0.

include_all_stores.description: First load every store this page holds back, as its all-prices button does. Defaults to false.

product_id.description: Numeric BestPrice product id, as any tool returns it.

tools.name: get_comparison
tools.description: Lists the products in the shopper’s comparisons, per category; changes nothing.

offset.description: Use next_offset from the previous result to read more categories. Defaults to 0.

tools.name: get_listing_filters
tools.description: Lists this listing’s filters, their values and its sort options; changes nothing.

group.description: A filter key or name from a previous call; returns that filter with all of its values.

offset.description: Use next_offset from the previous result with the same group, or none. Defaults to 0.

tools.name: get_page_product
tools.description: Reads the product on this page: id, title, lowest price, store count and rating; changes nothing.

tools.name: get_product_specifications
tools.description: Reads this product’s specifications, all or by section or fact; changes nothing.

section.description: all, or a section name in English or Greek as a previous call returned it, e.g. Display or Οθόνη.

limit.description: Maximum number of specification facts to return, from 1 to 16.

fact.description: A fact name a previous call returned, or a common English one such as screen size or weight.

offset.description: Use next_offset from the previous result with the same section. Defaults to 0; not with fact.

tools.name: get_shopping_decision
tools.description: Recommends what to buy for a described need or budget, with alternatives and reasons; changes nothing.

message.description: The shopper’s need in their own words, e.g. a phone for photos; budget and must-haves go in their own fields.

max_price_eur.description: Highest item price in euros the shopper will pay.

must_have.description: Features the pick must have, one per item, e.g. NFC.

postal_code.description: Optional five-digit Greek delivery postcode the shopper gave; adds shipping and delivered totals.

tools.name: get_shopping_list
tools.description: Lists the products in the shopper’s shopping list; changes nothing.

limit.description: Products to return, from 1 to 20. Defaults to 10.

offset.description: Use next_offset from the previous result to read on. Defaults to 0.

tools.name: get_visible_products
tools.description: Lists the product cards shown on this page; changes nothing.

limit.description: Maximum products to return, up to 8 per call; next_offset continues.

offset.description: Use next_offset from the previous result on this page. Defaults to 0.

tools.name: load_more_products
tools.description: Loads the next page of results into this listing, as scrolling does.

tools.name: open_price_alert
tools.description: Opens this product’s price-drop alert dialog; the shopper sets and saves the alert there.

product_id.description: Numeric BestPrice product id, as any tool returns it.

tools.name: open_product
tools.description: Opens a product’s BestPrice page in this tab by product_id.

product_id.description: Numeric BestPrice product id, as any tool returns it.

tools.name: open_search_results
tools.description: Opens a search’s results_url in this tab, so the shopper sees those results.

results_url.description: A results_url exactly as a search returned it.

tools.name: remove_from_comparison
tools.description: Removes this page’s product from the shopper’s side-by-side comparison for its category; never adds one.

product_id.description: Numeric BestPrice product id, as any tool returns it.

tools.name: remove_from_shopping_list
tools.description: Removes this page’s product from the shopper’s shopping list; never adds one.

product_id.description: Numeric BestPrice product id, as any tool returns it.

tools.name: search_bestprice
tools.description: Finds products by name, brand, model or category in BestPrice’s catalog; changes nothing.

query.description: A product name, brand, model or category, in Greek or English.

limit.description: Maximum results to return, from 1 to 8. Defaults to 6.

min_price_eur.description: Only products from this price in euros (item price before shipping).

max_price_eur.description: Only products up to this price in euros (item price before shipping).

sort.description: Result order. relevance is the default; newest, biggest_price_drop and most_stores only where offered.

in_stock_only.description: Only products a store has in stock now. Defaults to false.

deals_only.description: Only products priced below their earlier price. Defaults to false.

tools.name: show_offer
tools.description: Scrolls to one store offer on this page and highlights it; opens no store site.

offer_ref.description: Pass offer_ref (from compare_page_offers) or, failing that, merchant_name. Refused once that offer changes.

merchant_name.description: Only without offer_ref: the store name exactly as compare_page_offers returned it, for one offer.

tools.name: summarize_price_history
tools.description: Summarizes this product’s price history and trend; show_chart also shows the chart.

show_chart.description: Also open or scroll to the price-history chart on this page for the shopper. Defaults to false.
